name: Binangun

queries.query: Binangun Cilacap Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN
queries.result: Discovery identified the official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive map, the ATLAS geospatial portal, and the official Cilacap land-office site. No Binangun-specific public parcel endpoint or safe feature response was exposed in indexed first-party content.

queries.query: Binangun Cilacap peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN
queries.result: Pencarian berbahasa Indonesia menemukan portal resmi BHUMI/ATLAS ATR/BPN dan situs Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Cilacap, tetapi tidak menemukan layanan publik khusus Binangun dengan respons bidang tanah anonim yang memuat ID asli dan geometri.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Cilacap is the evidenced local land-office custodian, but its public site did not expose a Binangun parcel map/API in this attempt.
regionalOrNationalSources: BHUMI ATR/BPN is the national ministry's public interactive geospatial map surface and states that it can present land parcels and other spatial layers.

ATLAS is the national ATR/BPN geospatial catalog. Its public landing page loaded, but the anonymous catalog response rendered zero published sources during the bounded request and no Binangun parcel dataset was identified.
The Cilacap land-office site documents land services and local office information, but general service prose is not parcel-vector evidence.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: No city-specific public registry/map/procedure with usable Binangun parcel geometry and stable native identity was identified; registryFound remains null.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET of https://bhumi.atrbpn.go.id/ returned HTTP 200 and referenced the current iframe https://konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id. TLS-verified GET of the iframe and inspection of its current JavaScript entrypoints found public application routes and token-gated service configuration, but no anonymous Binangun parcel feature request was safely exposed. TLS-verified GET of https://atlas.atrbpn.go.id/ returned HTTP 200; current Next.js assets and the public landing page were inspected, with no Binangun parcel layer, schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry response obtained. TLS-verified GET of https://atrbpncilacap.or.id/ and https://www.bpnkabcilacap.com/layanan/ was represented by indexed official content; no parcel vector endpoint was exposed. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disable was used.

attemptedRoutes.route: Official BHUMI ATR/BPN map help and landing surface
attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official help page confirms the interactive map is integrated with ATLAS and supports spatial layers including land parcels. This is national capability documentation, not evidence of Binangun coverage.
HTTP 200; current page iframe and JavaScript entrypoints were followed to konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id. No safe anonymous Binangun parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

HTTP 200; current public catalog landing page and JavaScript assets were inspected. The rendered anonymous catalog showed zero published sources at inspection time and no Binangun parcel dataset, service URL, schema, CRS, or feature response was exposed.
Official-looking Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Cilacap site was identified, including local land-office context and land-value-zone material, but no public Binangun parcel vector service was found.
Public service page describes electronic/online land services and the local office. It does not expose an anonymous parcel layer or safe geometry endpoint.
